item.title: Zimbabwean sungura veteran Nicholas Zakaria dies aged 69
item.description: Zimbabwean sungura musician Nicholas Zakaria has died aged 69, his family has confirmed. In a statement released on his official Facebook page, the family said: “It is with profound sadness that we announce the passing of Nicholas Zakaria, the talented musician and beloved member of our community. Nicholas left an indelible mark on the music world with his inspiring voice and dedication to his craft. His legacy will live on through his music, and he will be deeply missed by fans and loved ones.

item.title: Nigeria: CKay’s Love Nwantiti surpasses 1bn Spotify streams
item.description: Nigerian musician CKay has reached a major milestone, with his track ‘Love Nwantiti’ surpassing one billion streams on Spotify. The achievement makes him one of the few African artists to reach the mark and the first Nigerian solo act to do so on the platform. Released in 2019 on the EP CKay the First, the song began as a modest regional hit before gaining widespread international attention. item.title: Open call: AmaGroove Residency 2026 in SA
item.description: The organisers of the AmaGroove Residency have announced an open call for artists to participate in the programme’s third edition, scheduled to take place from 22 to 29 March 2026 at Kromdraai Impact Hub in South Africa. Established as a collaborative platform for musicians and producers from South Africa and abroad, AmaGroove aims to support creative experimentation, cultural exchange and long-term artistic development. item.title: Shazam unveils feature spotlighting songs’ top moments
item.description: Shazam has announced a new feature aimed at enhancing music discovery by identifying the moments within tracks that generate the most listener interest. The tool, called Popular Segments, was rolled out on Shazam.com on 10 December. According to Shazam, the feature highlights sections of songs that prompted the highest volume of Shazam activity over the previous week. item.title: 2025 GQ Men of the Year Awards in SA: All the honourees
item.description: The 2025 GQ Men of the Year Awards were held at the Fairlawns Boutique Hotel in Johannesburg, South Africa on 10 December to recognise leading figures across music, sport, business, and culture. In the music category, Africori-signed artist Sjava received the Excellence in Music Award, following the release of his September project Uyena.
